bulk_argument.seed: Original scalar step decreases q and writes position q. Fill [lower,q) excludes that seed.
bulk_argument.count: min(q-stop, group_end-1-rem) ends at last index below exclusive group_end; rem258 is scalar.
bulk_argument.strictness: Current metadata requires every literal>0; seed vc<vl sets nxt high C. C+maximum<2^32 prevents the next literal cost wrapping; same lc keeps continuation high C, so it wins strictly regardless of low choice tie.
bulk_argument.choice: chd<=0xfffffefd and rem<=258 keep chd+rem<2^32; dlit<2^32 prevents low choice from contaminating upper cost.
bulk_argument.ring: count<=31<1024 yields distinct ring slots and at most two physical segments. All values are independent of fill order because kc/high are cached and this phase has no ring-min push lookup.
bulk_argument.writes: Seed establishes q<s.len(), q<out.len(), end>q. Fill p is below q, so helper bounds cover all count positions in actual call.
bulk_argument.nxt: After both ascending segments, q=lower and nxt reconstructs the cell for lower (the final position in original descending traversal), not the last physically written cell.
